user.title: Energy costs and tariffs
user.description: Import and export are tracked separately. Enter prices in the shown currency (e.g. 0.30 for 30 cents/kWh in EUR). An empty effective date means today. The tariff at the same date is replaced; other tariff periods remain. Backdated prices recalculate recorded days. Monthly advances/credits are assumed paid on the billing-start day each month. Positive opening balance means credit in your favour. Without an opening balance a partially observed billing year is marked incomplete.
